results.message: the revised coordinate became the active navigation-controller target 0.093 s after MISSION_ACK (limit 1.000 s), reported 0.58 m from the commanded coordinate; the controller had been steering 91.26 m away before the revision, so the move is unambiguous. Mission storage revision seen=True; transfer took 0.006 s and is excluded. POSITION_TARGET_GLOBAL_INT is the active navigation-controller target; MISSION_ITEM_INT is mission storage only. Adoption is judged within 2.0 m because the controller reports its own target through an EKF-origin round trip, never the commanded integers
